fallbacks: No bits-ui Toast namespace exists — plain DOM carries the source's own live-region roles/aria.

dataFlow.reason: Client-side queue fed by useToastStack() calls; no route data.

guards: All browser APIs live inside $effect or event handlers, which never run during SSR; server render is the empty list.

verification.evidence: 0 errors / 0 warnings in toast-stack files (whole-project run).

verification.purpose: Port gates: files, verbatim CSS, prop parity, manifest

gaps: Phase 1 still-port by design: no motion library wired. layoutStack() is ported verbatim and applied as static inline geometry (translateY/scale/height/opacity); the enter rise, hover fan-out springs, height morphs, icon/text/action-width swaps (AnimatePresence/popLayout), the loading spinner keeps its CSS keyframes, and dismiss is instant with no leave fade or sink/throw.

React context + useSyncExternalStore became a $state-backed ToastStackStore class in toast-stack-store.svelte.ts with Svelte context; useToastStack() keeps ARC's throw-outside-provider. One deliberate asymmetry: a viewport with no provider falls back to a local store instead of throwing, so lone previews work.
Port-only `store` prop on the provider (inject a pre-made store; used by the demo). Documented here; ARC constructs internally only.
Swipe-to-dismiss pointer gestures are omitted in Phase 1 (no 1:1 finger follow, rubber-band, velocity projection, or spring-back). Dismissal is via close button, Escape, action, timer, or API.
Height measuring uses bind:offsetHeight + $effect instead of ResizeObserver (equivalent, Svelte-idiomatic).

Focus hand-off after a keyboard dismiss targets the toast at the same index (or the last live one), then the pre-stack return focus — ARC's inert-filtered next/previous walk simplified to index-stable.
Outgoing-copy aria-hidden handoff has no leaving copies in Phase 1, so the live region always reads current text (same simplification as toast).
Reduced-motion and expanded/content targets collapse to the same static geometry; the spinner animation is stilled by the verbatim CSS media query.
